# unknown-kind-and-op

An entry of a kind this build does not know, then an intent holding an op it does not know beside a known one, after the writer's last entry.

Laid over the state `one-writer-open`. Its bytes are written by hand in `tests/format/generate.rs`, each line sealed by toshokan 0.1.0 with `cargo test -p toshokan --test format -- --ignored --exact generate::fixtures`.
